data.name: Moutasam
data.gender_notes: Moutasam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who fulfills a promise or a covenant, a pledge, a guarantee. The name Moutasam carries the meaning “Promise, covenant, pledge” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Moutasam usually hope their child will grow to embody promise, covenant, pledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Moutasam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Promise, covenant, pledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Moutasam total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: موتسم
in_arabic.long_meaning: موتسم هو اسم عربي يعني الشخص المتسم بالحسن والجمال، ينبع من الجذر العربي وسم، الذي يعني علامة أو سمات، وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في التراث الإسلامي لوصف الشخص الذي يتميز بالخير والكمال، ويتضمن هذا الاسم روحانية وإيمانية في الإسلام

in_urdu.name: موتسم
in_urdu.meaning: نام کا معنی ہے حسن اور جمال سے متسم
in_urdu.long_meaning: موتسم ایک عرب نام ہے جو حسن اور جمال سے متسم شخص کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے، یہ نام عرب جڑ وسم سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے نشان یا خصوصیات، اور اسلامی روایت میں خیر اور کمال کے ساتھ شخص کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: मोतसं
in_hindi.meaning: नाम का अर्थ है सुंदरता और आकर्षण से परिपूर्ण
in_hindi.long_meaning: मोतसं एक अरबी नाम है जो सुंदरता और आकर्षण से परिपूर्ण व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है, यह नाम अरबी मूल वسم से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है चिह्न या विशेषताएं, और इस्लामी परंपरा में भलाई और उत्कृष्टता के साथ व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: موتسم
in_pashto.meaning: د نوم معنا دی چې ښکلا او ځلا سره ډک
in_pashto.long_meaning: موتسم د عربي نوم دی چې ښکلا او ځلا سره ډک شخص لپاره کارول کیږي، دا نوم د عربي ریښې وسم څخه اخیستل شوی، چې معنا یې نښه یا ځانګړتیاوې دي، او د اسلامي دود په خیر او کمال سره شخص لپاره کارول کیږي

data.cultural_impact: The name Moutasam reflects the importance of fulfilling commitments and maintaining honesty, which is a key value in many aspects of Islamic culture. It is a reminder of the significance of upholding promises, whether they are made to Allah, family members, or community members.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Moutasam reflects the concept of accountability in Islam. It emphasizes the importance of living up to our promises and commitments to Allah, and striving to be true to our faith. It is a reminder of the consequences of our actions, both in this world and in the next. Ultimately, it is a call to be responsible, trustworthy individuals who fulfill our duties to ourselves, others, and Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Promise, covenant, pledge" symbolizes One who fulfills a promise or a covenant, a pledge, a guarantee. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Moutasam serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of promise, covenant, pledge.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidāyah wa l-Nihāyah, under the entry for caliph Al-Mansur (754-775 CE), mentions Moutasam ibn Al-Assad as the governor of Egypt during Al-Mansur's early caliphate.

Al-Baladhuri's Ansab al-Ashraf, under the entry for the Abbasid revolution (747-750 CE), mentions Moutasam ibn Al-Assad as a prominent figure who supported the Abbasid cause and was later appointed as the governor of Kufa by the new Abbasid caliph, Al-Saffah.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Moutasam, which is of Arabic origin and means 'confirmation' or 'support', is gaining popularity in modern contexts across various platforms. On social media, it is often used as a unique and meaningful username for individuals identifying with Islamic or Middle Eastern culture. Personal blogs may feature a post about the significance of this name or its meaning in personal experiences. Online marketplaces, such as Etsy, may offer customized baby name art or jewelry featuring the name Moutasam in Arabic calligraphy as a popular design choice for individuals of Islamic or Middle Eastern descent.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Aisha Moutasam in Cairo, Egypt attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Moutasam, which means "Promise, covenant, pledge". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
